chapterInfo.content:
17
Apam no ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ
1 # Gye 35.11; Eks 6.3; Gye 48.15 Na Abram dii mfirinhyia aduɔkron nkron no, AWURADE yii ne ho kyerɛɛ no kaa sɛ: Mene Onyankopɔn Tweaduampɔn, nante m’anim, na yɛ pɛ. 2Na mɛma m’apam ada me ne wo ntam, na mama woadɔ kɛse ara. 3Na Abram daa hɔ de n’anim butuu fam; na Onyankopɔn ne no kasaa sɛ: 4Me deɛ, hwɛ, m’apam da hɔ ma wo, na mɛyɛ wo aman pii agya.
5 # Rom 4.11, 17 Na wɔremfrɛ wo din Abram#17.5 ABRAM: Asekyerɛ ne: Agya a wɔama no soɔ. bio, na mmom wɔbɛfrɛ wo Abraham,#17.5 ABRAHAM: Asekyerɛ ne: Nipakuo agya. ɛfiri sɛ mayɛ wo aman pii agya. 6Na mɛma woadɔ pii pa ara, na mɛyɛ wo aman, na ahemfo afiri wo mu. 7Na mɛma me ne wo ne w’asefoɔ a ɛbɛdi w’akyire no apam agyina wɔ wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mu, na ayɛ daa apam, na mayɛ wo ne w’asefoɔ a ɛbɛdi w’akyire no Nyankopɔn. 8#Gye 23.4; 35.27; Heb 11.9-16 Na mede asase a woyɛ so hɔhoɔ yi, Kanaan asase nyinaa, bɛma wo ne w’asefoɔ a ɛbɛdi w’akyire, sɛ daa agyapadeɛ, na mayɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn.
9Na Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: Wo deɛ, di m’apam so, wo ne w’asefoɔ a ɛbɛdi w’akyi wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mu. 10#Lew 12.3; Aso 7.8 Yei ne me ne w’asefoɔ a ɛbɛdi w’akyire no ntam apam a monni soɔ: Wɔntwitwa mo mu mmarima nyinaa twetia. 11Na montwitwa mo ho twetia, na ayɛ me ne mo ntam apam no ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ. 12Na ɔbabarima biara a wadi nna nwɔtwe no, montwa no twetia mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mu, deɛ wɔawo no fie ne deɛ wɔde sika tɔɔ no wɔ ɔhɔhoɔ biara a ɔnyɛ w’aseni nkyɛn. 13Twa deɛ wɔawo no wɔ wo fie ne deɛ wɔde wo sika tɔɔ no twetia, na m’apam atena mo honam mu sɛ daa apam. 14Na ɔbarima momonoto biara a wɔntwaa no twetia no, saa onipa no wɔbɛtwa no afiri ne man mu, ɛfiri sɛ wato m’apam.
15Na Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: Wo yere Sarai deɛ, mfrɛ no Sarai bio, na mmom Sara.#17.15 SARA: Asekyerɛ ne: Ɔhene babaa. Saa nkyerɛaseɛ yi ara na wɔde ma edin Sarai. 16Na mɛhyira no, na mama wo ne mu ɔba nso, ampa ara, mɛhyira no. Ɔbɛyɛ aman, na aman ahemfo bɛfiri ne mu.
17 # Gye 18.12; 21.6; Luka 1.18 Na Abraham de n’anim butuu fam seree, na ɔkaa no n’akomam sɛ: Yee! Wɔbɛwo ɔba ama deɛ wadi mfirinhyia ɔha, na Sara a wadi mfeɛ aduɔkron no bɛwo anaa? 18Na Abraham ka kyerɛɛ Onyankopɔn sɛ: O, ɛnneɛ anka ma Ismael nya w’anim adom ɛ! 19#Gye 26.3 Na Onyankopɔn kaa sɛ: Ampaneampa, wo yere Sara bɛwo ɔba ama wo, na woato ne din Isak.#17.19 ISAK: Asekyerɛ ne: Sereɛ. Na mɛma me ne no apam no agyina ayɛ daa apam ama n’asefoɔ a ɛbɛdi n’akyire no. 20#Gye 16.10; 21.13, 18; 25.16 Na Ismael ho deɛ, matie wo. Hwɛ, mɛhyira no, na mama no awo, na wadɔɔso pii pa ara. Atitire dummienu na ɔbɛwoɔ, na mayɛ no ɔman kɛseɛ. 21Na m’apam deɛ, me ne Isak a Sara bɛwo no ama wo afeda sɛsɛɛ no na ɛbɛpam ama no agyina. 22#Gye 35.13 Na ɔne no wiee kasa no, Onyankopɔn firii Abraham nkyɛn kɔɔ ɔsoro.
23Na Abraham faa ne ba Ismael ne wɔn a wɔawo wɔn wɔ ne fie ne wɔn a ɔde ne sika tɔɔ wɔn nyinaa, Abraham fiefoɔ mu mmarima nyinaa, na ɔtwitwaa wɔn twetia da no ara, sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ no no. 24Na Abraham adi mfirinhyia aduɔkron nkron na wɔtwaa no twetia. 25Na ne ba Ismael adi mfeɛ dummiɛnsa na wɔtwaa no twetia. 26Da no ara na wɔtwitwaa Abraham ne ne ba Ismael twetia. 27Na ne fie mmarima nyinaa, wɔn a wɔwoo wɔn ne fie ne wɔn a wɔde sika totɔɔ wɔn wɔ ahɔhoɔ nkyɛn, wɔtwitwaa wɔn twetia kaa ne ho.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na Abram dii mfirinhyia aduɔkron nkron no, AWURADE yii ne ho kyerɛɛ no kaa sɛ: Mene Onyankopɔn Tweaduampɔn, nante m’anim, na yɛ pɛ. Na mɛma m’apam ada me ne wo ntam, na mama woadɔ kɛse ara. Na Abram daa hɔ de n’anim butuu fam; na Onyankopɔn ne no kasaa sɛ: Me deɛ, hwɛ, m’apam da hɔ ma wo, na mɛyɛ wo aman pii agya.
Na wɔremfrɛ wo din Abram bio, na mmom wɔbɛfrɛ wo Abraham, ɛfiri sɛ mayɛ wo aman pii agya. Na mɛma woadɔ pii pa ara, na mɛyɛ wo aman, na ahemfo afiri wo mu. Na mɛma me ne wo ne w’asefoɔ a ɛbɛdi w’akyire no apam agyina wɔ wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mu, na ayɛ daa apam, na mayɛ wo ne w’asefoɔ a ɛbɛdi w’akyire no Nyankopɔn. Na mede asase a woyɛ so hɔhoɔ yi, Kanaan asase nyinaa, bɛma wo ne w’asefoɔ a ɛbɛdi w’akyire, sɛ daa agyapadeɛ, na mayɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn.
Na Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: Wo deɛ, di m’apam so, wo ne w’asefoɔ a ɛbɛdi w’akyi wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mu. Yei ne me ne w’asefoɔ a ɛbɛdi w’akyire no ntam apam a monni soɔ: Wɔntwitwa mo mu mmarima nyinaa twetia. Na montwitwa mo ho twetia, na ayɛ me ne mo ntam apam no ho nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ. Na ɔbabarima biara a wadi nna nwɔtwe no, montwa no twetia mo awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mu, deɛ wɔawo no fie ne deɛ wɔde sika tɔɔ no wɔ ɔhɔhoɔ biara a ɔnyɛ w’aseni nkyɛn. Twa deɛ wɔawo no wɔ wo fie ne deɛ wɔde wo sika tɔɔ no twetia, na m’apam atena mo honam mu sɛ daa apam. Na ɔbarima momonoto biara a wɔntwaa no twetia no, saa onipa no wɔbɛtwa no afiri ne man mu, ɛfiri sɛ wato m’apam.
Na Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ Abraham sɛ: Wo yere Sarai deɛ, mfrɛ no Sarai bio, na mmom Sara. Na mɛhyira no, na mama wo ne mu ɔba nso, ampa ara, mɛhyira no. Ɔbɛyɛ aman, na aman ahemfo bɛfiri ne mu.
Na Abraham de n’anim butuu fam seree, na ɔkaa no n’akomam sɛ: Yee! Wɔbɛwo ɔba ama deɛ wadi mfirinhyia ɔha, na Sara a wadi mfeɛ aduɔkron no bɛwo anaa? Na Abraham ka kyerɛɛ Onyankopɔn sɛ: O, ɛnneɛ anka ma Ismael nya w’anim adom ɛ! Na Onyankopɔn kaa sɛ: Ampaneampa, wo yere Sara bɛwo ɔba ama wo, na woato ne din Isak. Na mɛma me ne no apam no agyina ayɛ daa apam ama n’asefoɔ a ɛbɛdi n’akyire no. Na Ismael ho deɛ, matie wo. Hwɛ, mɛhyira no, na mama no awo, na wadɔɔso pii pa ara. Atitire dummienu na ɔbɛwoɔ, na mayɛ no ɔman kɛseɛ. Na m’apam deɛ, me ne Isak a Sara bɛwo no ama wo afeda sɛsɛɛ no na ɛbɛpam ama no agyina. Na ɔne no wiee kasa no, Onyankopɔn firii Abraham nkyɛn kɔɔ ɔsoro.
Na Abraham faa ne ba Ismael ne wɔn a wɔawo wɔn wɔ ne fie ne wɔn a ɔde ne sika tɔɔ wɔn nyinaa, Abraham fiefoɔ mu mmarima nyinaa, na ɔtwitwaa wɔn twetia da no ara, sɛdeɛ Onyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ no no. Na Abraham adi mfirinhyia aduɔkron nkron na wɔtwaa no twetia. Na ne ba Ismael adi mfeɛ dummiɛnsa na wɔtwaa no twetia. Da no ara na wɔtwitwaa Abraham ne ne ba Ismael twetia. Na ne fie mmarima nyinaa, wɔn a wɔwoo wɔn ne fie ne wɔn a wɔde sika totɔɔ wɔn wɔ ahɔhoɔ nkyɛn, wɔtwitwaa wɔn twetia kaa ne ho.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
